page: Microsoft Azure NC24ads_A100_v4 is a GPU-accelerated server belonging to the NCADSA100v4 family. It features 24 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 7V13 processor running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 220 GB of system memory, providing 9.17 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA A100 Ampere GPU equipped with 80 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 1026 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance in LLM inference tasks. For small, medium, and large models, both prompt processing and text generation speeds rank in the top 10% tier. Passmark memory benchmarks also place the system in the top 10% tier. Single-core stress-ng CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench image processing are strong, ranking in the top 25%. Other metrics, including multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations, perform in the average range.

Given the inclusion of a high-capacity 80 GB VRAM GPU, dedicated AMD EPYC cores, and local NVMe storage, this server offers high resource density. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive parallel processing alongside substantial memory footprints. The hardware profile is optimized for large language model inference, deep learning, data science, and memory-intensive GPU-accelerated workloads.
